LB::connlimit
       Set the connection limit for virtual/node/poolmember.

SYNOPSIS
       LB::connlimit ('virtual' | 'node' | 'poolmember')
			     ((limit (unlimited | LIMIT)) |
			      (key KEY))?

DESCRIPTION
       Set the connection limit for virtual/node/poolmember

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
